name: io.gamedock.sdk.utils.agegate.AgeGateActivity
description: When the app runs a configured Gamedock age check, this Activity asks the user to choose an age range and reports whether the configured threshold is met. A blocking age gate keeps the screen open for age ranges below that threshold.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents configured age checks from being completed and may interrupt age-gated Gamedock startup or access.
